w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📯 MUSTER — scouts report The Rerun hunting near Haven, and it is beyond us. Everyone inside. No one walks the treeline alone — the garden crews double up, the hunters stand down. We outlast it.
firstContext: You catch fragments by the fire — Ethan telling Sanne about you. The story's getting bigger than what happened.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.

noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ Aurora Schmitz walks out of the light alone, which is how they walked in — but the table keeps the contract they priced, because the galaxy still needs what they taught it. The village endures, and this time the table owes the village.
